questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

“Alas, I have broken my brother’s watch!” said he.

options.text: He exclaimed with sorrow that he may have broken his brother’s watch.
He exclaimed with sorrow I have broken my brother’s watch.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he has broken his brother’s watch.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he had broken his brother’s watch.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e., '**He exclaimed with sorrow that he had broken his brother’s watch.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an **exclamatory sentence. **
 
• While changing the **narration of an exclamatory sentence,** we need the following steps
 
 
• The first person 'I' will be changed into 'he'.
 
• The **reporting verb said** is changed to **exclaimed with sorrow** (The given sentence talks about an unfortunate incident.)
 
• The **conjunction 'that'** is used in place of commas and inverted commas.
 
• The verb (have broken) is in the **present perfect tense form** in the given sentence. In the indirect speech, it will change to **past perfect tense (had broken).**
 
• The first person **my brother's** will be changed into **his brother's.**
 
 
 
• Eventually, we will get the final sentence - **He exclaimed with sorrow that he had broken his brother’s watch.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the following idiom.**

To be light years away

options.text: To be too distant for human beings to reach
An unlikely event that happened suddenly
An extremely long time from now in the past or future
When something seems like it is about to happen in the near future

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To be too distant for human beings to reach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To be light years away"** means to refer to something that is extremely far away or distant, usually beyond the reach of human beings. (बहुत दूर होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Technological advancements that we can only dream of now might be light years away.
 
 
 
• Option 1 **"To be too distant for human beings to reach"** accurately captures this meaning. ( मनुष्यों के पहुंच से बहुत दूर)
 
 
• **Example: **Exploring galaxies beyond our Milky Way is light years away in terms of current space travel technology.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of the idiom "To be light years away" is best matched by option 1.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2** An unlikely event that happened suddenly (असंभव घटना जो अचानक घटित हो गई)

 
 
• **Example:** Winning the lottery is an unlikely event that happened suddenly.
 
 
 
• **Option 3** An extremely long time from now in the past or future (अत्यधिक लंबे समय से अब या भविष्य में)
 
 
• **Example: ** The extinction of dinosaurs happened light years ago.
 
 
 
• **Option 4** When something seems like it is about to happen in the near future (जब कुछ ऐसा होता है कि भविष्य में होने वाला है)
 
 
• **Example:** The launch of the new product is about to happen in the near future.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. A fox, hearing the cock and thinking to make a meal of him, came and stood under the tree.

B. As the night passed away and the day dawned, the cock, according to his custom, set up a shrill crowing.

C. A dog and a cock having struck up an acquaintance went out on their travels together.

D. Nightfall found them in a forest, so the cock, flying up on a tree, perched among the branches, while the dog dozed below at the foot.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e., 'CDBA'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When arranging sentences, it is easier to order the first few; and then eliminate the options accordingly. 
 
• The first sentence of a paragraph is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 
 
• Here, only C is independent and introduce a topic related to the friendship between a dog and a cock who went on travels together.
 
• It should be followed by D which expands the story about their journey.
 
• So, D must come after C. Then CD is the correct order.
 
• This order is shown in option 2, which shows the full sequence as: CDBA.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is: CDBA

**C. **A dog and a cock having struck up an acquaintance went out on their travels together.

**D.** Nightfall found them in a forest, so the cock, flying up on a tree, perched among the branches, while the dog dozed below at the foot.

**B.** As the night passed away and the day dawned, the cock, according to his custom, set up a shrill crowing.

**A. **A fox, hearing the cock and thinking to make a meal of him, came and stood under the tree.

• Example: She learned how to ride a horse during her summer vacation at the ranch.

• Example: The church bells rang out loudly on Christmas morning.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that beat is the correct synonym for the word bang.
